questions.question: A batch of eight finishes in four milliseconds. Which statement follows for a fully occupied serial worker?
options: Every example experiences half a millisecond of response latency
The compute-throughput proxy is two thousand examples per second, while batch execution still takes four milliseconds
The service can guarantee the same throughput for every arrival pattern
questions.explanation: Eight examples per four milliseconds gives two thousand per second when batches remain full. A request still waits for collection and the full execution, plus any other boundary costs.
